chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from al-Barqī, from Saʿd ibn Saʿd al-Ashʿarī, he said:
Al-Riḍā عليه السلام said regarding the two sajdahs of forgetfulness: if there has been a deficiency, then before the taslim, and if there has been an addition, then after it.

key_terms.التَّسْلِيمِ: the concluding salutation ending the prayer
key_terms.بَعْدَهُ: after it, meaning after the taslim
key_terms.زَادَتْ: there occurred an addition in the prayer
key_terms.سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ: the two prostrations performed for forgetfulness in salat (prayer)
key_terms.نَقَصَتْ: there occurred a deficiency or omission in the prayer

ai.seo_question: When are the two sajdahs of forgetfulness performed before or after the taslim in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the timing of the two sajdahs of forgetfulness in salat (prayer). It states that when there is a deficiency, they are performed before the taslim, and when there is an addition, they are performed after it.
